notes.subject: go Babilone
notes.rationale: Babilone o alwa a sa le lefaseng, seso sa sefela sa Seheberu se fetotšwe go ba 'wena' ga se na bong ka Sepedi

notes.subject: o tšweleditše
notes.rationale: תפושי (puš): 'go phaphamala/go tuma' (KJV 'grown fat') kgahlanong le 'go ithiba ka boikaelego' (ASV 'wanton')

notes.subject: bjaseng
notes.rationale: דשה: 'bjaseng/mohlare' (KJV, JPS) kgahlanong le 'go goga korong' go tšwa motheong wa dšš (ASV 'treading grain')

notes.subject: dipoo tša maatla
notes.rationale: אברים 'ba maatla': dipoo (KJV) kgahlanong le dipere tša madira (ASV/JPS, ka lebaka la tsahal 'go kwea ka dipere')

translation: Ka gobane o nyakafetše, ka gobane o iṣhokotše, wena yo a ṡhwaišago boṣwa bja ka; ka gobane o tšweleditše bjalo ka konyane ya dikgomo bjaseng, gomme o dira modumu bjalo ka dipoo tša maatla —
